name: azure-devops
author: Coddy
description: Lists the active pull requests of an Azure DevOps repository and their comments, through its REST API.

settings.title: Personal access token
settings.description: A token that may read code (Code: Read), kept in the system's keyring. Without one, AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT.

settings.title: Organization URL
settings.description: Only for Azure DevOps Server on your company's own machine: its collection's URL.
